howItWorks.title: Live in 3 steps, no coding needed

steps.title: Connect your Facebook Page
steps.body: Enter your Page ID and access token in the dashboard, or connect with Facebook in one click.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.body: Add name, price, stock and delivery charge. Upload many products at once with a CSV.

steps.title: AI replies and takes orders
steps.body: Replies go out on Messenger, and orders land in your dashboard and your Google Sheet.

features.title: Everything an online seller needs, in one place

cards.title: Replies in Bangla and Banglish
cards.body: However customers write, the AI understands and answers only from your catalog. It never makes up things that aren't there.

cards.title: Automatic order collection
cards.body: Collects name, phone, address and quantity inside the chat and confirms the order.

cards.title: Risk score for fake orders
cards.body: Warns you about wrong numbers, vague addresses or unusual quantities.

cards.title: Orders in Google Sheets
cards.body: Every order goes straight to your own Sheet.

cards.title: Fallback and take over
cards.body: When the AI doesn't know, it sends your own fallback message, and you can continue the chat yourself.

cards.title: One dashboard for everything
cards.body: See and manage orders, conversations, products and risk reports in one place. Confirm or cancel in one click.

items.a: Usually 5-10 minutes. Create an account, connect your Facebook Page and add your products. The AI starts replying right after.

items.q: Which Facebook Pages does it work with?
items.a: Any Facebook Page with Messenger turned on. You only need to be an admin of the Page.
Yes. Customers can write in Bangla, Banglish or English and the AI understands and replies.

items.q: What happens when the AI doesn't know an answer?
items.a: It never makes anything up. It sends your own fallback message, and you can then talk to the customer yourself.

items.q: Is my Page and data safe?
items.a: Your Page token is stored encrypted. Your products, customers and orders stay in your account only, and no one else can see them.
No. Everything is done from the dashboard in Bangla. If you get stuck, we help you set up.
